regressions.issue: The inner loop's header is now 'while True' and its condition is an 'if' inside the body, after four calldata-offset requires. The requires depend only on idx and calldata, so they are invariant in this loop. The old text (requires before the loop, 'while t < len') was exact and much clearer.
regressions.rule: A check in a loop condition block whose operands are loop-invariant (calldata, outer variables) passes on every iteration if it passes once, and the block runs at least once. Hoist such checks before the loop and keep the remaining comparison as the while condition.
